channel.title: Fair Dinkum Publishing
channel.description: Practical guides for Australian small business owners navigating AI, compliance, and digital publishing.

item.title: The AU AI Compliance Playbook: What Australian Small Businesses Need to Know
item.description: The Privacy Act 1988 changed. APP 1.7 now covers automated decisions. Here's what OAIC enforcement means for your business — and a 90-day checklist to get compliant.

item.title: From Manuscript to Market: Our Digital Publishing Workflow
item.description: How we use AI agents, Google Drive, and Composio to write, assemble, and publish digital products — without burning out or cutting corners.

item.title: Why Australian Small Business Needs Better AI Tools
item.description: Most AI guides are written for US or EU audiences. We're building for Australian operators — sole traders, tradies, and small teams who need practical, locally-relevant advice.
